description: Urbanization and its impact on flood risk: The case of Addis Ababa, Ethiopia is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by figshare. Addis Ababa city rainfall raw data (1976-2016) acquired from Ethiopian meteorological agency. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher figshare. Its tags are 40107 Meteorology, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences, 120599 Urban and Regional Planning not elsewhere classified, FOS: Social and economic geography. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
